QuestInfo.name: What She Remembered
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has news for you. Listen to what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce has news for you. Listen to what she has to say.
QuestInfo.2: You rushed to go see Mercedes when you heard she'd be visiting. You overheard Athena telling Mercedes about you, but Mercedes doesn't seem to remember you at all. You flee before she has a chance to see you.
